resources.string: Emberr is now available in 18 languages, from Español and Deutsch to 日本語 and हिन्दी. It follows your computer's language, or you can pick one yourself. Emberr restarts to switch. Spotted an odd translation? Let us know on GitHub.

Emberr is now available in 18 languages, from Español and Deutsch to 日本語 and हिन्दी. It follows your phone's language, or you can pick one yourself. On Android 13 and newer, you can also set it in your phone's **Settings → Apps → Emberr → Language**. Spotted an odd translation? Let us know on GitHub.
Pick from 13 color themes, like Nord, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Rosé Pine and High Contrast. Each one has a strength setting, and you can choose whether text and icons follow it too.

Pick from 14 color themes, like Nord, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Rosé Pine and High Contrast, or let **Wallpaper** take its colors from your wallpaper. Each one has a strength setting, and you can choose whether text and icons follow it too. Your home screen widgets follow the theme as well.
Give the app a soft grain, like real paper. Set how strong it is, and choose where it shows: the whole app, notes, canvas or Daily Notes.
Make everything in the app bigger or smaller, from 80% to 200%, or use **Ctrl +**, **Ctrl −** and **Ctrl 0**.
Make everything in the app bigger or smaller, from 80% to 200%.
Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Emberr

Every widget has a cleaner new look, and there are three new ones: **Note card**, **Jot it down** and **Quote of the day**. Widgets now show the note you picked right away, and tell you when that note has been deleted.
The slash menu now opens right after any character, not only after a space. If you type past a match, delete back and the menu comes back.
Sliders across the app have a new design.
Type **/** in a note's title to add the current time or date.
Add the current time or date to a note's title from the keyboard toolbar.
The network choice for sync is now in **Settings → Sync & Backup**.
Search ignores accents, so **uber** also finds **Über**, and emoji search understands your language.
Japanese, Korean and Chinese text needs a CJK font such as Noto Sans CJK. Without one, those characters show as boxes.
Leave by 8am to beat the traffic.
The Overstory, Piranesi, Project Hail Mary
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
